g.title: Platt calibration and fallback
g.desc: Clip the fused score and take its logit. Use the calibrated probability when fitting succeeds, both label classes are present, the score standard deviation exceeds ten to the minus eight, and the slope is nonnegative. Otherwise use the fused score.

g.aria-label: z equals logit of q bar clipped between epsilon sub q and one minus epsilon sub q
